 Rival Watch: Real Madrid rule Thibaut Courtois out of El Clasico
 Bad news for the visitors.
 by Barca Blaugranes Oct 25, 2026, 11:03 AM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 MADRID, SPAIN - OCTOBER 21: Thibaut Courtois of Real Madrid seen prior to the UEFA Champions League 2026/27 League Phase MD3 match between Real Madrid CF and RB Leipzig at Estadio Santiago Bernabeu on October 21, 2026 in Madrid, Spain. (Photo by Kazimierz Koper/Eurasia Sport Images/Getty Images) Getty Images Real Madrid have confirmed that goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois will miss El Clasico after dropping out of the squad at the last minute.
 The stopper had been expected to start the match against Barcelona at Camp Nou but has now been ruled out due to illness.
 “Courtois is a last-minute absence due to a flu-like illness for tonight’s match between Real Madrid and Barcelona, corresponding to the tenth matchday of La Liga. Illia Voloshyn has been called up in his place,” the club said in a statement.
 Back-up stopper Andriy Lunin is now expected to take Courtois’ place between the sticks for Real Madrid against Barcelona.
 The news will be a blow for Jose Mourinho and his side as they head to Catalunya for Sunday’s big match between the two sides.
 Real Madrid head into the fixture already six points behind Barcelona in the title race and now four behind Atletico in second after Diego Simeone’s side beat Deportivo on Saturday night.
